summary: Leggett & Platt filed an 8-K reporting expiration of the HSR waiting period for its acquisition by Somnigroup International Inc. (Parent) via a merger with Merger Sub, where Leggett & Platt will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary. The HSR 30-day waiting period expired on June 3, 2026. The transaction is subject to shareholder adoption, foreign competition and investment clearances in Canada, EU, UK, South Korea, and Austria, SEC S-4 effectiveness, and no material adverse effect. Close is expected by year-end 2026. Watch for shareholder vote timing and regulatory approvals.
